otto-log.description:
Query the unified trail root and AI usage across otto-workbench scripts — audit trail plus cost and token stats

When to use: Tracing what an AI script did (recent, query, show, list), seeing what AI calls cost across scripts, tasks, models, and days (stats), or reclaiming the trail root ahead of its retention horizon (prune). One user command spans several processes; show takes any of their invocation IDs and renders the whole command

Usage: otto-log recent [--since <since>] [--repo <repo>] [--json]  |  otto-log query [--script <script>] [--level <level>] [--event-type <event-type>] [--invocation <invocation>] [--root <root>] [--pr <pr>] [--repo <repo>] [--since <since>] [--json]  |  otto-log show [--only] [--json] <invocation>  |  otto-log list [--script <script>] [--since <since>] [--repo <repo>] [--json]  |  otto-log record --script <script> --action <action> [--detail <detail>] [--level <info|warn|error>] [--data <key=value>] [--repo <repo>] [--pr <pr>]  |  otto-log prune [--keep <keep>]  |  otto-log stats [--since <since>] [--by <script|task|model|provider|day|phase>] [--json]

otto-queue.description:
Machine-wide queue for background work — admits a command against the heavy/light budget or queues it as a job for an on-demand worker, de-duplicates it by key, and records it in a per-machine ledger

When to use: Heavy or memory-hungry work an agent starts itself (generators, full builds, `pr review --self --fix`): `otto-queue run --ticket --class heavy -- CMD` runs in the current terminal after admission. Never use `submit` for interactive work — it detaches output to queue/logs. Do not pass `--key` for work that must re-run: a done key is reused without running. Inside a queued job (`OTTO_QUEUE_ENTRY` set), just run the command. If `otto-queue` is not installed, run the command bare. Exit 75 means the ledger is busy and nothing ran.

Usage: otto-queue run --ticket [--class <heavy|light>] [--key <key>] [--force] [--no-reuse] [--wait <wait>] ...  |  otto-queue submit [--class <heavy|light>] [--key <key>] [--force] [--no-reuse] [--queue-only] ...  |  otto-queue worker [--idle <idle>]  |  otto-queue status [--json]  |  otto-queue cancel <id>
